17.t: Working with data: a family’s electricity bill
q: In which month was most electricity used?
Suggest why use is highest from April to August.
The hot season: air conditioners and fans run for many hours.
Calculate how much the family would save in June by using 20% less, and suggest how.
20% of 460 = 92 kWh; 92 × 2500 = 230 000 VND. Set the air conditioner 1-2 °C warmer, turn it off when out, use fans.
